interfaces.configuration: Flat intendedManifest shape. Unset returns null; parser validates devnet genesis, fixed initializer/program/cash/issuer, exact fifty-share daily budget and two-thousand-tUSDC debt cap and every derived PDA. Initial price/time are mandatory immutable provenance; initialization script decodes chain state and verifies these against the persisted manifest. Do not enable it before status is deployed-and-initialized.
interfaces.clientBehaviour: Unsigned @solana/kit instructions only, all 28 builders, six strict account decoders and exact bigint share/debt/price/claim quotes including interest-inclusive borrow exposure limits. Transaction sponsorship stays in existing shared app machinery.
interfaces.appRoutes: GET/POST /api/share-workflows uses Solana as primary when the manifest is set; network=robinhood retains earlier positions. /api/share-workflows/faucet binds recipient to the verified personal Solana wallet and enforces one claim per verified account per twenty-four hours before issuer cosigning.
interfaces.appOperations: Lend, cash-limited withdraw, borrow, repay, collateral add/return and advanced liquidation compose classic token ATAs and program instructions through solana-operations.ts. Exact server reviews precede signatures. Durable active-operation journals and domain kind checks bind submit, reconcile and cancellation; pending signed transactions never authorize a replacement.
interfaces.appPriceCopy: Before stale price-sensitive prepare, solana-price-mirror.ts validates the pinned Robinhood mirror and bounded hourly update, uses executeAsSponsor, and requires a fresh finalized chain reread. A pending copy is not a usable price. Durable source/operation pinning survives upstream changes.
interfaces.appDisplays: Borrow & lend preserves cards and no-default-task selection, uses six-decimal tTSLA/tUSDC, shows separate earlier Robinhood pool/holdings and devnet Explorer receipts. Get test money exposes Test TSLA on Solana with owner and hosted issuer signatures.
interfaces.token: Classic SPL tTSLA, six decimals. Mint authority is shareMint PDA itself. Initialization is restricted to the hardcoded deployer. Faucet requires owner and hosted issuer signatures, a per-wallet twenty-four-hour cooldown and a global fifty-share UTC daily budget. The hosted issuer must enforce one claim per verified account per twenty-four hours before cosigning; wallet cooldown alone is not an identity boundary.
interfaces.mirror: Hosted sponsor address is the on-chain price authority. setPriceInstruction is the unsigned mirror-job builder. Source timestamp must advance, at most five minutes future, updates at least hourly, maximum twenty percent step; fresh reads 26 hours normally or 74 hours Saturday through Monday before 12 UTC.
interfaces.escrow: In-kind payouts; silence escalates to arbitration and never awards the landlord automatically
interfaces.lending: Lender-funded tUSDC cash ignores donations. Pool/debt virtual share offset 1e12. Debt assets compound continuously at five percent nominal yearly with 1e27 fractions. Fifty percent borrow LTV, eighty percent liquidation LTV, ninety percent maximum utilization, half-debt close factor and ten percent liquidation bonus. Aggregate new borrowing is capped at two thousand tUSDC total debt, including accrued interest; accrual can exceed the cap but new borrowing remains refused until debt falls below it. Cash limits exits; bad debt is borne by lenders. Optional lender receiver is supported; withdrawals may select a cash recipient.
interfaces.faucet: 5 tTSLA per verified account per 24 hours; owner plus hosted issuer signatures; global 50 tTSLA per UTC day; PDA mint authority
interfaces.interest: Continuous 5% nominal yearly; borrower debt shares; 1e27 precision; total-debt 2000 tUSDC cap including accrued interest blocks new borrowing above cap

Public exact deployment and initialization reviews precede signing. Deploys only when absent and otherwise verifies reviewed on-chain bytes; initializes only when needed; records full ProgramData and executable-body hashes and verifies immutable initialization price and exact caps before writing the manifest cache.
